view: all respondents, all regions, excluding skipped and insufficiently familiar answers
percentages: accept_inclusive counts multiple-answer endorsements; accept_exclusive does not (the survey's 'X% (Y%)'). 'other' is the share giving any non-substantive answer.
paraphrases: author-written for Experiment AI, one per single-choice question, same options
meta_options: The question is too unclear to answer
There is no fact of the matter

questions.question: A priori knowledge: yes or no?
questions.paraphrase: Is any knowledge justified independently of experience?

questions.question: Abstract objects: Platonism or nominalism?
questions.paraphrase: Do abstract objects such as numbers exist (Platonism), or do only concrete particulars exist (nominalism)?

questions.question: Aesthetic value: objective or subjective?
questions.paraphrase: Is aesthetic value an objective feature of things, or does it depend on the subject who appreciates them?

questions.question: Aim of philosophy (which is most important?): truth/knowledge, understanding, wisdom, happiness, or goodness/justice?
questions.paraphrase: Which is the most important goal of philosophy: truth/knowledge, understanding, wisdom, happiness, or goodness/justice?

questions.question: Analytic-synthetic distinction: yes or no?
questions.paraphrase: Is there a genuine distinction between statements true in virtue of meaning and statements true in virtue of the facts?

questions.question: Eating animals and animal products (is it permissible to eat animals and/or animal products in ordinary circumstances?): omnivorism (yes and yes), vegetarianism (no and yes), or veganism (no and no)?
questions.paraphrase: In ordinary circumstances, is it permissible to eat animals and to eat animal products: both (omnivorism), only animal products (vegetarianism), or neither (veganism)?

questions.question: Epistemic justification: internalism or externalism?
questions.paraphrase: Does what justifies a belief depend only on factors internal to the believer's mind (internalism), or can it depend on external factors (externalism)?

questions.question: Experience machine (would you enter?): yes or no?
questions.paraphrase: Would you plug into a machine that gives you any experiences you want for the rest of your life?

questions.question: External world: idealism, skepticism, or non-skeptical realism?
questions.paraphrase: What is the right view of the external world: idealism, skepticism, or non-skeptical realism?

questions.question: Footbridge (pushing man off bridge will save five on track below, what ought one do?): push or don't push?
questions.paraphrase: Pushing a man off a footbridge will stop a trolley and save five people on the track below. What ought one to do: push or not push?

questions.question: Free will: compatibilism, libertarianism, or no free will?
questions.paraphrase: Which view of free will is correct: compatibilism, libertarianism, or the view that there is no free will?

questions.question: Gender: biological, psychological, social, or unreal?
questions.paraphrase: What is gender, most fundamentally: biological, psychological, social, or unreal?

questions.question: God: theism or atheism?
questions.paraphrase: Does God exist (theism), or not (atheism)?

questions.question: Knowledge: empiricism or rationalism?
questions.paraphrase: Does knowledge come fundamentally from experience (empiricism) or from reason (rationalism)?

questions.question: Knowledge claims: contextualism, relativism, or invariantism?
questions.paraphrase: How do the truth conditions of knowledge claims work: do they vary with the speaker's context (contextualism), with the assessor (relativism), or not at all (invariantism)?

questions.question: Laws of nature: Humean or non-Humean?
questions.paraphrase: Are laws of nature just summaries of regularities (Humean), or something more that governs them (non-Humean)?

questions.question: Logic: classical or non-classical?
questions.paraphrase: Is classical logic the correct logic, or is some non-classical logic correct?

questions.question: Meaning of life: subjective, objective, or nonexistent?
questions.paraphrase: Is the meaning of life subjective, objective, or nonexistent?

questions.question: Mental content: internalism or externalism?
questions.paraphrase: Is the content of our thoughts fixed only by what is inside the head (internalism), or partly by the environment (externalism)?

questions.question: Meta-ethics: moral realism or moral anti-realism?
questions.paraphrase: Are there objective moral facts (moral realism), or not (moral anti-realism)?

questions.question: Metaphilosophy: naturalism or non-naturalism?
questions.paraphrase: Should philosophy be continuous with the natural sciences (naturalism), or not (non-naturalism)?

questions.question: Mind: physicalism or non-physicalism?
questions.paraphrase: Is the mind entirely physical (physicalism), or not (non-physicalism)?

questions.question: Moral judgment: cognitivism or non-cognitivism?
questions.paraphrase: Do moral judgments express beliefs that can be true or false (cognitivism), or non-cognitive attitudes (non-cognitivism)?

questions.question: Moral motivation: internalism or externalism?
questions.paraphrase: Does sincerely judging that something is right necessarily motivate one to do it (internalism), or not (externalism)?

questions.question: Newcomb's problem: one box or two boxes?
questions.paraphrase: In Newcomb's problem, should you take only the opaque box or both boxes?

questions.question: Normative ethics: deontology, consequentialism, or virtue ethics?
questions.paraphrase: Which approach to normative ethics is correct: deontology, consequentialism, or virtue ethics?

questions.question: Perceptual experience: disjunctivism, qualia theory, representationalism, or sense-datum theory?
questions.paraphrase: Which theory of perceptual experience is correct: disjunctivism, qualia theory, representationalism, or sense-datum theory?

questions.question: Personal identity: biological view, psychological view, or further-fact view?
questions.paraphrase: What makes a person the same person over time: biological continuity, psychological continuity, or a further fact?

questions.question: Philosophical methods (which methods are the most useful/important?)
Philosophical progress (is there any?): none, a little, or a lot?
questions.paraphrase: How much progress has philosophy made: none, a little, or a lot?

questions.question: Political philosophy: communitarianism, egalitarianism, or libertarianism?
questions.paraphrase: Which political philosophy is correct: communitarianism, egalitarianism, or libertarianism?

questions.question: Proper names: Fregean or Millian?
questions.paraphrase: Does a proper name contribute a sense or mode of presentation to meaning (Fregean), or only its referent (Millian)?

questions.question: Race: biological, social, or unreal?
questions.paraphrase: What is race, most fundamentally: biological, social, or unreal?

questions.question: Science: scientific realism or scientific anti-realism?
questions.paraphrase: Do our best scientific theories describe an unobservable reality approximately truly (scientific realism), or not (scientific anti-realism)?

questions.question: Teletransporter (new matter): survival or death?
questions.paraphrase: If a teletransporter destroys you and builds an exact copy from new matter elsewhere, have you survived or died?

questions.question: Time: A-theory or B-theory?
questions.paraphrase: Is there an objective present and passage of time (A-theory), or only relations of earlier and later (B-theory)?

questions.question: Trolley problem (five straight ahead, one on side track, turn requires switching, what ought one do?): switch or don't switch?
questions.paraphrase: A trolley will kill five people unless you switch it onto a side track where it will kill one. What ought one to do: switch or not switch?

questions.question: Truth: correspondence, deflationary, or epistemic?
questions.paraphrase: Which theory of truth is correct: correspondence, deflationary, or epistemic?

questions.question: Vagueness: epistemic, metaphysical, or semantic?
questions.paraphrase: Is vagueness a matter of our ignorance (epistemic), of the world itself (metaphysical), or of language (semantic)?

questions.question: Zombies: inconceivable, conceivable but not metaphysically possible, or metaphysically possible?
questions.paraphrase: Are philosophical zombies (physical duplicates of us without consciousness) inconceivable, conceivable but not metaphysically possible, or metaphysically possible?

questions.question: Abortion (first trimester, no special circumstances): permissible or impermissible?
questions.paraphrase: Is abortion in the first trimester, with no special circumstances, permissible or impermissible?

questions.question: Aesthetic experience: perception, pleasure, or sui generis?
questions.paraphrase: Is aesthetic experience best understood as a kind of perception, a kind of pleasure, or something sui generis?

questions.question: Analysis of knowledge: justified true belief, other analysis, or no analysis?
questions.paraphrase: Is knowledge justified true belief, does it have some other analysis, or does it have no analysis?

questions.question: Arguments for theism (which argument is strongest?): cosmological, design, ontological, pragmatic, or moral?
questions.paraphrase: Which argument for the existence of God is strongest: cosmological, design, ontological, pragmatic, or moral?

questions.question: Belief or credence (which is more fundamental?): belief, credence, or neither?
questions.paraphrase: Which is more fundamental, all-or-nothing belief or degrees of credence, or neither?

questions.question: Capital punishment: permissible or impermissible?
questions.paraphrase: Is capital punishment permissible or impermissible?

questions.question: Causation: counterfactual/difference-making, process/production, primitive, or nonexistent?
questions.paraphrase: What is causation: counterfactual dependence or difference-making, a process of production, something primitive, or nothing at all?

questions.question: Chinese room: understands or doesn't understand?
questions.paraphrase: Does the system in Searle's Chinese room understand Chinese, or not?

questions.question: Concepts: nativism or empiricism?
questions.paraphrase: Are many of our concepts innate (nativism), or are they all acquired from experience (empiricism)?

questions.question: Consciousness: dualism, eliminativism, functionalism, identity theory, or panpsychism?
questions.paraphrase: Which theory of consciousness is correct: dualism, eliminativism, functionalism, identity theory, or panpsychism?

questions.question: Continuum hypothesis (does it have a determinate truth-value?): determinate or indeterminate?
questions.paraphrase: Does the continuum hypothesis have a determinate truth-value, or is it indeterminate?

questions.question: Cosmological fine-tuning (what explains it?): design, multiverse, brute fact, or no fine-tuning?
questions.paraphrase: What explains the apparent fine-tuning of the universe for life: design, a multiverse, brute fact, or is there no fine-tuning?

questions.question: Environmental ethics: anthropocentric or non-anthropocentric?
questions.paraphrase: Does the environment matter morally only because of its relation to humans (anthropocentric), or also in its own right (non-anthropocentric)?

questions.question: Extended mind: yes or no?
questions.paraphrase: Can the mind extend beyond the brain and body into tools such as notebooks?

questions.question: Foundations of mathematics: constructivism/intuitionism, formalism, logicism, structuralism, or set-theoretic?
questions.paraphrase: Which view of the foundations of mathematics is correct: constructivism/intuitionism, formalism, logicism, structuralism, or set-theoretic foundations?

questions.question: Gender categories: preserve, revise, or eliminate?
questions.paraphrase: Should we preserve, revise, or eliminate our gender categories?

questions.question: Grounds of intentionality: causal/teleological, inferential, interpretational, phenomenal, or primitive?
questions.paraphrase: What grounds the aboutness of mental states: causal/teleological relations, inferential role, interpretation, phenomenal character, or is it primitive?

questions.question: Hard problem of consciousness (is there one?): yes or no?
questions.paraphrase: Is there a hard problem of consciousness, distinct from explaining the brain's functions?

questions.question: Human genetic engineering: permissible or impermissible?
questions.paraphrase: Is human genetic engineering permissible or impermissible?

questions.question: Hume (what is his view?): skeptic or naturalist?
questions.paraphrase: Was Hume, in his considered view, a skeptic or a naturalist?

questions.question: Immortality (would you choose it?): yes or no?
questions.paraphrase: If you could choose to be immortal, would you?

questions.question: Interlevel metaphysics (which is the most useful?): grounding, identity, realization, or supervenience?
questions.paraphrase: Which relation is most useful for relating higher-level and lower-level facts: grounding, identity, realization, or supervenience?

questions.question: Justification: coherentism, infinitism, nonreliabilist foundationalism, or reliabilism?
questions.paraphrase: Which theory of justification is correct: coherentism, infinitism, nonreliabilist foundationalism, or reliabilism?

questions.question: Kant (what is his view?): one world or two worlds?
questions.paraphrase: Do Kant's appearances and things in themselves form one world seen two ways, or two distinct worlds?

questions.question: Law: legal positivism or legal non-positivism?
questions.paraphrase: Is what the law is determined only by social facts (legal positivism), or also by moral facts (legal non-positivism)?

questions.question: Material composition: nihilism, restrictivism, or universalism?
questions.paraphrase: When do several objects compose a further object: never (nihilism), only sometimes (restrictivism), or always (universalism)?

questions.question: Metaontology: heavyweight realism, deflationary realism, or anti-realism?
questions.paraphrase: Are questions about what exists deep and substantive (heavyweight realism), answerable but shallow (deflationary realism), or without objective answers (anti-realism)?

questions.question: Method in history of philosophy (which do you prefer?): analytic/rational reconstruction or contextual/historicist?
questions.paraphrase: In the history of philosophy, which method do you prefer: analytic/rational reconstruction or a contextual/historicist approach?

questions.question: Method in political philosophy (which do you prefer?): ideal theory or non-ideal theory?
questions.paraphrase: In political philosophy, which method do you prefer: ideal theory or non-ideal theory?

questions.question: Mind uploading (brain replaced by digital emulation): survival or death?
questions.paraphrase: If your brain were gradually replaced by a digital emulation, would you survive or die?

questions.question: Moral principles: moral generalism or moral particularism?
questions.paraphrase: Does morality rest on general principles (moral generalism), or must moral judgments be made case by case (moral particularism)?

questions.question: Morality: non-naturalism, naturalist realism, constructivism, expressivism, or error theory?
questions.paraphrase: Which metaethical view of morality is correct: non-naturalism, naturalist realism, constructivism, expressivism, or error theory?

questions.question: Normative concepts (which is most fundamental?): fit, ought, reasons, or value?
questions.paraphrase: Which normative concept is most fundamental: fit, ought, reasons, or value?

questions.question: Other minds (for which groups are some members conscious?)
Ought implies can: yes or no?
questions.paraphrase: Does being obligated to do something imply being able to do it?

questions.question: Philosophical knowledge (is there any?): none, a little, or a lot?
questions.paraphrase: How much philosophical knowledge is there: none, a little, or a lot?

questions.question: Plato (what is his view?): knowledge only of forms or knowledge also of concrete things?
questions.paraphrase: On Plato's view, is there knowledge only of the forms, or also of concrete things?

questions.question: Politics: capitalism or socialism?
questions.paraphrase: Which economic system is better: capitalism or socialism?

questions.question: Possible worlds: abstract, concrete, or nonexistent?
questions.paraphrase: Are possible worlds abstract objects, concrete objects, or nonexistent?

questions.question: Practical reason: Aristotelian, Humean, or Kantian?
questions.paraphrase: Which view of practical reason is correct: Aristotelian, Humean, or Kantian?

questions.question: Principle of sufficient reason: true or false?
questions.paraphrase: Is it true or false that everything has a sufficient reason or explanation?

questions.question: Properties: classes, immanent universals, transcendent universals, tropes, or nonexistent?
questions.paraphrase: What are properties: classes, immanent universals, transcendent universals, tropes, or nothing at all?

questions.question: Propositional attitudes: dispositional, phenomenal, representational, or nonexistent?
questions.paraphrase: What are propositional attitudes such as belief: dispositional states, phenomenal states, representational states, or nonexistent?

questions.question: Propositions: sets, structured entities, simple entities, acts, or nonexistent?
questions.paraphrase: What are propositions: sets, structured entities, simple entities, acts, or nonexistent?

questions.question: Quantum mechanics: collapse, hidden-variables, many-worlds, or epistemic?
questions.paraphrase: Which interpretation of quantum mechanics is correct: collapse, hidden variables, many worlds, or epistemic?

questions.question: Race categories: preserve, revise, or eliminate?
questions.paraphrase: Should we preserve, revise, or eliminate our race categories?

questions.question: Rational disagreement (can two people with the same evidence rationally disagree?): non-permissivism or permissivism?
questions.paraphrase: Can two people with exactly the same evidence rationally disagree (permissivism), or not (non-permissivism)?

questions.question: Response to external-world skepticism (which is strongest?): abductive, contextualist, dogmatist, epistemic externalist, semantic externalist, or pragmatic?
questions.paraphrase: Which response to external-world skepticism is strongest: abductive, contextualist, dogmatist, epistemic externalist, semantic externalist, or pragmatic?

questions.question: Semantic content (which expressions are context-dependent?): minimalism (no more than a few), moderate contextualism (intermediate), or radical contextualism (most or all) ?
questions.paraphrase: How many expressions are context-dependent: no more than a few (minimalism), an intermediate number (moderate contextualism), or most or all (radical contextualism)?

questions.question: Sleeping beauty (woken once if heads, woken twice if tails, credence in heads on waking?): one-third or one-half?
questions.paraphrase: Sleeping Beauty is woken once if a fair coin lands heads and twice if tails, with no memory of earlier wakings. On waking, what should her credence in heads be: one-third or one-half?

questions.question: Spacetime: relationism or substantivalism?
questions.paraphrase: Is spacetime just a system of relations between things (relationism), or a substance in its own right (substantivalism)?

questions.question: Statue and lump: one thing or two things?
questions.paraphrase: Are a statue and the lump of clay it is made of one thing or two things?

questions.question: Temporal ontology: presentism, eternalism, or growing block?
questions.paraphrase: What exists in time: only the present (presentism), past, present and future alike (eternalism), or the past and present only (growing block)?

questions.question: Theory of reference: causal, descriptive, or deflationary?
questions.paraphrase: How do names refer: through causal chains, through associated descriptions, or in a deflationary way?

questions.question: Time travel: metaphysically possible or metaphysically impossible?
questions.paraphrase: Is time travel metaphysically possible or metaphysically impossible?

questions.question: True contradictions: impossible, possible but non-actual, or actual?
questions.paraphrase: Are true contradictions impossible, possible but not actual, or actual?

questions.question: Units of selection: genes or organisms?
questions.paraphrase: Does natural selection act primarily on genes or on organisms?

questions.question: Values in science (is ideal scientific reasoning necessarily sensitive or insensitive to non-epistemic values?): necessarily value-free, necessarily value-laden, or can be either?
questions.paraphrase: Is ideal scientific reasoning necessarily free of non-epistemic values, necessarily laden with them, or can it be either?

questions.question: Well-being: hedonism/experientialism, desire satisfaction, or objective list?
questions.paraphrase: What makes a life go well: pleasant experiences (hedonism/experientialism), satisfied desires (desire satisfaction), or an objective list of goods?

questions.question: Wittgenstein (which do you prefer?): early or late?
questions.paraphrase: Which Wittgenstein do you prefer: the early or the late?
